Feather vendors the SideSign library from Odysseus at commit 6ec6d6062ed6ccc3460fdb6b16323c03dbcc4cbd. Odysseus sources it from SideStore/Catalyst. SideSign is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Its license is in this directory.

The adjacent CodeSignKit and GSACryptoKit libraries come from their respective upstream revisions d0c67710fda9a2646b9e829cb2cf443892728371 and eae2590eaf17fe98ce9c76b3ec2bd42b780eb123. Both are AGPL-3.0. Their manifests and CryptoExtras imports are adapted for Feather’s Swift Crypto 3 dependency.
